name: Suzuki Hiroto
source:
A 1st year high schooler.
[url=/c51802]Shinobu's[/url] older cousin.
He had transferred to a school in America in order to fulfill his dream of being a professional sports player, but he injured his shoulder the same as [url=/c51799]Chihiro[/url] and had to give up on his dream.
After coming back to Japan he is recuperating in the summer house owned by his uncle, Shinobu's father.
